attributes.description:
Applies a shadow effect around the calendar container to create depth and visual hierarchy. Higher elevation values create more pronounced shadows.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-wrapper-shadow

Sets the color of the border surrounding the calendar container. This affects the outer edge of the entire calendar component.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-wrapper-border-color

Defines the style of the calendar's border. Available options: solid, dashed, dotted, double, groove, ridge, inset, outset, or none.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-wrapper-border-style

Controls the thickness of the calendar's border. Larger values create a more prominent border around the calendar's edges.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-wrapper-border-width

Adjusts the roundness of the calendar's corners. Higher values create softer, more rounded corners.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-wrapper-border-radius

Sets the background color for the calendar wrapper, providing the base color for the entire calendar component.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-wrapper-background

Sets the width of the calendar component. A value of 100% makes the calendar responsive to its container's width.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-width

Sets the minimum height of the calendar, ensuring consistent spacing even with minimal content.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-min-height

Defines the background color for the calendar header, which contains navigation controls and title.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-header-background-color

Sets the thickness of the border for the calendar header, creating visual separation from the calendar body.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-header-border-width

Specifies the style of the header's border. Options: solid, dashed, dotted, double, groove, ridge, inset, outset, or none.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-header-border-style

Defines the border color for calendar events, affecting the visibility of event content.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-header-border-color

Adjusts the corner rounding for the calendar header, creating a softer or more angular appearance.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-header-border-radius

Sets the padding of the calendar header (top/bottom: space.2, left/right: space.0). Creates space above and below the header content.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-header-padding

Defines the background color for the calendar header, which contains navigation controls and title.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-weekday-background-color

Sets the thickness of the border below weekday labels, creating visual separation from the calendar days.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-weekday-border-width

Defines the style of the border below weekday labels. Options: solid, dashed, dotted, double, groove, ridge, inset, outset, or none.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-weekday-border-style

Sets the color of the border below weekday labels, creating visual separation from the calendar days.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-weekday-border-color

Controls the spacing around weekday labels, affecting the breathing room between text and container edges.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-weekday-padding

Specifies the font family for weekday text, allowing customization of the typography used for day names.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-weekday-text-font-family

Controls the size of the weekday text in the calendar. This affects how large the weekday labels appear.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-weekday-text-font-size

Sets the font weight for day numbers in the calendar, controlling the text thickness. Range: 100-900 or normal/bold.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-weekday-text-font-weight

Defines the color for interactive elements like navigation links within the calendar component.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-weekday-text-color

Controls the background color surrounding individual day cells in the calendar grid.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-daywrapper-background

Controls the border color surrounding individual day cells in the calendar grid.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-daywrapper-border-color

Defines the color for interactive elements like navigation links within the calendar component.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-day-color

Specifies the font family for day text, allowing customization of the typography used for day names.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-day-font-family

Controls the size of the day text in the calendar. This affects how large the day labels appear.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-day-font-size

Sets the font weight for header text, controlling how bold or light the text appears. Range: 100-900 or normal/bold.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-day-font-weight

Controls the border color surrounding individual day cells in the calendar grid.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-day-background

Defines the text color for days that fall outside the current month's date range, typically shown in a muted tone.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-not-day-of-month-color

Adjusts the font weight for days outside the current month, typically set lighter than current month days. Range: 100-900 or normal/bold.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-not-day-of-month-font-weight

Defines the color for interactive elements like navigation links within the calendar component.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-month-text-color

Specifies the font family for month text, allowing customization of the typography used for day names.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-month-text-font-family

Sets the font weight for month text, controlling how bold or light the text appears. Range: 100-900 or normal/bold.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-month-text-font-weight

Defines the color for year-text within the calendar component.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-year-text-color

Specifies the font family for weekday text, allowing customization of the typography used for day names.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-year-text-font-family

Sets the font weight for year-text, controlling how bold or light the text appears. Range: 100-900 or normal/bold.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-year-text-font-weight

Defines the background color for the today.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-today-background-color

Defines the color for today within the calendar component.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-today-border-color

Defines the background color for the calendar today.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-today-text-background-color

Defines the primary color for event indicators on calendar days, used to visually mark days with scheduled events.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-event-day1-color1

Sets the second color variant for event days in the calendar. This determines what color appears for the second event indicator.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-event-day1-color2

Sets the third color variant for event days in the calendar. This determines what color appears for the third event indicator.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-event-day1-color3

Sets the background color of calendar events. This determines what color appears behind event content.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-selected-day-background

Sets the background color for the selected day's text container, creating a highlight effect for better visibility.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-selected-day-text-background

Defines the background color for the calendar header, which contains navigation controls and title.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-selected-day-text-color

Sets the font weight for selected-day text, controlling how bold or light the text appears. Range: 100-900 or normal/bold.
CSS variable: --wm-calendar-selected-day-text-font-weight
